frequency_question: How often do major secondary financial sanctions against systemically important foreign banks for energy purchases materialize within the designated window?
membership_rule: Cases involving formal designation, threat of exclusion from correspondent banking, or actual sanctioning of top-tier foreign financial institutions for purchasing energy from heavily embargoed states by a primary global reserve currency issuer.

cases.name: 2012 NDAA implementation actions against Chinese banks for Iranian oil
2018 Iran-related secondary sanction designations on financial entities
2023 Russian oil price cap financial facilitator enforcement actions

coverage_note: 4 named historical escalation clusters; representative of modern secondary financial enforcement patterns.
known_gaps: Excludes low-level warning letters and informal diplomatic demarches that did not reach formal sanction status.
skeleton: Selected historical major enforcement actions against financial facilitators of restricted energy trade divided by total high-profile escalation cycles since 2010.
multiplier: 3 hits out of 4 distinct high-stakes escalation cycles evaluated over comparable windows.
validity_reason: Based on institutional frameworks of the primary global financial hegemon which remain stable across multi-year congressional cycles.
